resources.string: Works with GameScrcpy on your computer
GameScrcpy on the computer is starting the connection.
Mirror this phone in GameScrcpy over USB debugging, or scan the code in GameScrcpy\'s control window to connect over Wi-Fi.
GameScrcpy on this computer is older: switches changed here are kept and sent to a computer that can take them.
These switches are this phone\'s settings in GameScrcpy on the computer too: change them on either side.
Shows where the computer\'s mouse points
While the mouse is over the picture on the computer, the phone\'s own screen shows where it points.
Draws the keys over the game here
Draws the keys of the current profile over the game on the phone, as in the mirror window. Without a picture, such as over AOA, they show by themselves.
Type into the phone from the computer
While mirroring, what you type on the computer, Chinese included, goes into the phone\'s input boxes through the GameScrcpy Companion input method.
Connects again by itself on Wi-Fi
On the same Wi-Fi, this phone connects by itself to the computers it was paired with by scanning, also after the connection drops.
What the companion does on this phone
The four switches are also this phone\'s settings in GameScrcpy on the computer, and a change on either side shows on both. Cursor size and style and the hint bar stay on this phone.
At the top the game is not pushed up; it needs Display over other apps.
Computers this phone has connected to
Mirror this phone in GameScrcpy over USB debugging, or scan the code in GameScrcpy\'s control window.
This phone forgets the computer and the settings it sent. To connect over Wi-Fi again, scan its code again.
What the companion needs and what for
Shows the cursor and the key hints over games.
Shows that the companion is connected, with Stop at hand.
Only for scanning the code in GameScrcpy\'s control window.
Lets the computer type into the phone. Over USB debugging GameScrcpy turns it on and chooses it by itself; without USB debugging, turn it on here once.
When the computer asks for a screenshot, Android asks you to allow the capture. While you play, that prompt needs Display over other apps or notifications to appear.

The companion app works with GameScrcpy on your computer: it shows the computer\'s cursor and key hints on this phone, lets you type with the computer\'s keyboard, and connects over Wi-Fi when there is no USB debugging.
The companion talks only to GameScrcpy on your own computers, over USB debugging or your Wi-Fi. It collects nothing and sends nothing anywhere else.
The companion is open source and uses these libraries.
